meta.story: Bablu ka Hotel (Hindi) EP7: ten tables and one waiter, ten minutes just to write the order; Ramu the cook waits because no order has come in; Kaka says the faster the order the faster the table frees up, put a QR on every table; Priya shows the full menu is on the table QR so guests browse and choose; Bablu: guests order themselves; Priya reports three extra tables and no guest waited to order
